blockers.summary: TOKEN_ONLY routing contract is not enforced on RoutingBinding.route_key.
blockers.evidence: validate_and_compile does not require route_key request_id, token_index and layer_index, routing-event priority/schema, selected ExpertKey.layer equality with route_key.layer_index, or operation-to-route request/token/layer identity.
blockers.required_remediation: Fail closed on every frozen token-level EventKey field and priority, require every selected expert to belong to the route layer, bind dispatch/compute/return/combine operations to the same request/token/layer identity, add negative regressions, and produce a fresh immutable candidate and sealed run.

claim_boundary: R1 Model blockers are substantively closed. Evidence remains CPU_SYNTHETIC, FUNCTIONAL_ONLY or ANALYTIC_FIRST_ORDER and RANGE_UNKNOWN. No routing-weight, benchmark-quality, Mixtral, measured-hardware, calibration, DSE or performance inference is supported.
authorized_next_stage: Phase 6 CPU-only remediation followed by a fresh immutable sealed run and independent three-role same-hash review only.
